summary: ExpressionRulesEngine: the filter engine. evaluate() (single context), evaluate_batch() (many contexts, one pass), explain() (unfiltered per-rule ternary detail). This revision hardens construction and batch boundaries: an explicit output_fields kwarg (expressions-only construction path) or DimensionsMetadata.output_fields is validated once against the rules' actual columns; hit_policy accepts a string and is rejected outright if unrecognized (no silent COLLECT fallback); top_n/min_specificity/top_n_per_context/chunk_size reject non-int, bool, or out-of-range values before scoring; evaluate_batch's context_id_field path globally validates null/duplicate ids and, when chunked, defers HitPolicyViolationError until every chunk is scored so the reported violation set is complete. The primary public entry point for 'find the best matching rule'.
lifecycle_notes: Construction requires exactly one nonempty dimension definition (metadata or expressions). Typed zero-rule inputs remain supported when their schema is valid.
Expressions-only construction accepts keyword-only output_fields; metadata-backed construction uses DimensionsMetadata.output_fields. Declared names are checked against the original rule schema.
dimensions=None selects all configured dimensions. Explicit projections must be nonempty lists of distinct names: malformed projections raise ValueError, unknown well-formed names raise KeyError.
Policy names are normalized explicitly; top_n, top_n_per_context and min_specificity allow None or nonnegative Python integers excluding bool, while chunk_size must be positive.

Global source context IDs are validated in _prepare_contexts before conversion or chunking. Generated IDs are assigned once to original input positions; results use __context_id rather than echoing the original context column.
chunk_size bounds each cross-join evaluation, not complete input staging: the chunk loop materializes prepared contexts as Polars and retains result or violation frames.
PRIORITY schema configuration is checked before scoring; null priority values are checked on survivors before ranking. UNIQUE/ANY assertions precede caller limits and specificity filtering.

Expressions-only ANY always needs explicit output_fields. Metadata-backed ANY may infer outputs; an empty inferred set is rejected when more than one survivor needs comparison, not automatically for zero or one survivor.

Retained __rank records policy order before caller filtering. When earlier ranks disappear, first_per_context selects the minimum remaining rank; top-N after a specificity filter selects remaining positions without rewriting __rank.
SelectionInfo.truncated is conservative: any supplied limit/threshold or FIRST/PRIORITY/ANY selection blocks later re-selection, even if it did not remove a row.
Chunked evaluation accumulates HitPolicyViolationError diagnostics across chunks and sorts offending context IDs; unrelated errors still propagate immediately.
Single and batch Boolean binding use the shared nullable helpers; explain exposes unfiltered scoring without ranked-selection semantics.
risks: Chunking is not a bound on total input/output or violation-memory usage and does not promise streaming.
The constructor captures the original rule-column schema; this profile establishes no guarantee for external sources whose schema changes after construction.
Abstract expression support does not imply every engine path works on every backend; per-row REGEX remains Polars-native and list/string predicate limits are recorded in README.md.
Shared filter validation affects accumulator apply even when accumulator source files are unchanged.

evidence.detail: Missing-context semantics, policy/output schema restrictions, batch identity and input boundaries are documented in the current source checkout; source bodies are authoritative.
